items.headline: A EUR 60 fine for a EUR 4 light
items.body: Every autumn Amsterdam commuters get fined for riding without lights, often because the lights were stolen the week before. We built Nachtfiets to end that loop: a pair of bright clip lights on subscription, and we replace them within 24 hours whenever they disappear. EUR 9 a month. We launch in October and the waitlist is open today.
items.rationale: Rewrite per Sofia: removed the unverified 'thousands' figure and softened the 24h promise to a plain statement.

message_to_team: Sofia, LinkedIn post rewritten: no numbers I cannot back, 24h stated plainly. Board, it is in your inbox with the other two.
